scheme_name: Establishment of 50 Milch Animals Dairy Unit
other_conditions: The applicant must purchase 50 dairy animals (cows or buffaloes).
The applicant must establish a new dairy farm.
The applicant must have ownership, inheritance, or leasehold rights to the land (lease minimum 7 years if land is not owned).
The applicant must take a loan from a Reserve Bank‑recognised institution or bank.
benefits_summary: Offers a 7.5% interest subsidy for up to 5 years on loans for 50 dairy animals, plus subsidies on shed construction, animal insurance, and key equipment up to specified maximum amounts.
